svg.title: evict-duo
svg.desc: DuoAttention on Llama-3-8B: half of the 256 KV heads (32 layers x 8) are retrieval heads that keep the full cache; the rest are streaming heads that keep 64 sink plus 256 recent tokens. At 128K tokens the BF16 cache falls from 16 GiB to about 8.02 GiB. Placement of heads in the grid is a toy; the 50% ratio is the paper's.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif
STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: retrieval: full KV (50% under GQA, 25% for MHA Llama-2-7B)
sink block: same idea as StreamingLLM (ch 05), per head
Gates α only: 2,000 steps on synthetic passkey recall, weights frozen; deploy α_h > τ (quantile) → retrieval head.
